text:
Alex: heads up — main pipeline turned red right after the auto-merge from PR #3412, smoke_gpu job failing :fire_engine:
ci-bot: buildkite: smoke_gpu (agent gpu-12) — failed 1m ago — exit code 1
Priya: looking at logs now, getting OOM in kv-cache test, stack shows `Alloc failed: cudaMalloc`
Sam: can someone rerun the smoke stage? quick sanity check before a bisect :eyes:
Alex: +1 rerun would be great, but if it's OOM it might be deterministic. @Jordan any idea?
Jordan: I'll take this. starting a bisect across recent merges (going to narrow down to the last 3 commits)
Priya: here's the failing log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T14:02:06Z] ERROR test_kv_cache.py::test_shard_alloc - Alloc failed: cudaMalloc returned 2
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/test_kv_cache.py", line 87, in test_shard_alloc
    buf = gpu_alloc(size)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
Sam: if bisect takes long, can we temporarily pin to previous runtime image in CI? quick rollback option
Alex: deploy-bot aborted the post-merge deploy earlier, looks like auto-rollout prevented a bad deploy :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment halted due to failing smoke checks (policy: block-on-smoke)
Jordan: bisect started — first candidate is the runtime tweak from @ralph (merged ~5m before failure). will report when I hit a reproducer
Priya: repro locally on a smaller shard by increasing batch size — adding a small patch to reduce default batch size to test impact
Sam: pinging @ralph for context on the runtime tweak, can you share kernel alloc change?
Ralph: (in another thread) saw this morning's change — it relaxed slab prealloc, didn't anticipate extra peak memory. happy to help revert if bisect confirms
Alex: plan: Jordan to finish bisect, Priya to try temp batch-size change in CI rerun, Sam to prepare quick revert PR if needed. thanks folks :coffee:
Jordan: update in ~10m, will @-mention when I have the offending commit
Priya: kicked a rerun of the smoke_gpu stage with batch-size=8 override — link: https://ci.example.com/build/6677
Sam: if rerun passes, we can unpause and let post-merge continue; if not, revert + hotfix.
Alex: tagging this thread as FYI for oncall rotation. thanks for fast responses.
